about.title: About SP Law Chamber
about.lede: A full-service law firm serving individuals, families and businesses with litigation, compliance and advisory support across India.
about.founderBio: Prem Prakash co-founded SP Law Chamber with Shruti Jain on a simple conviction: every client deserves counsel that listens first and advises honestly. He leads the firm's litigation practice across civil, criminal and constitutional matters, appearing before trial courts, tribunals and the High Court.
founderCredentials: B.A. LL.B, LL.M — University of Calcutta
Practises across civil, criminal and constitutional matters
Appears before trial courts, tribunals and the High Court
Co-founded SP Law Chamber with Shruti Jain
about.storyTitle: From a solo practice to a growing chamber
about.storyBody1: SP Law Chamber began as a solo practice built on referrals from satisfied clients. As the practice grew, advocates with complementary specialisations joined, allowing the firm to handle matters end-to-end — from drafting and registration to trial and appeal.
about.storyBody2: Today the firm advises families on personal matters, defends clients in civil and criminal proceedings, and represents them before tribunals, the High Court and in commercial and property disputes. Our goal is to remain the firm clients recommend to the people they care about.
